# Rancard Design System

> AI entry point for coding agents.

## Current Phase

Phase Zero — Build the documentation platform, repository architecture, governance, schemas, registries, and tooling before creating production tokens or components.

## Repository Goals

- Build a scalable design system platform.
- Keep documentation as the source of truth.
- Generate navigation and metadata from registries.
- Be accessible by default.
- Be understandable by both humans and AI agents.

## Constraints

- Do not invent production components.
- Do not invent token values.
- Do not invent package APIs.
- Use registries as the source of truth.
- Use `--docs-*` variables only for temporary documentation styling.
- Keep builds, linting, tests, and type checking passing.

## Planned Packages

- @rancard/react
- @rancard/react-native
- @rancard/tokens
- @rancard/themes
- @rancard/icons
- @rancard/css
- @rancard/cli

## Lifecycle

Planned → Experimental → Alpha → Beta → Stable → Deprecated → Removed
